_comment: Yuel (was Kindred; consumer brand per ADR-0024 — bundleId is com.hexastral.yuel (brand-aligned; internal codename stays kindred), internal codename stays kindred). App Store Connect ASO. LOCALE SCOPE NARROWED 2026-06 to the 4 languages the app actually ships: en-US, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja (founder decision, suite-wide with Yuun — the earlier 8-locale en-GB/ms/th/es-MX keyword-overflow expansion for SG/MY/TH/US-Spanish is deferred, not pursued for now). Set the App Store Connect Primary Language to English so every un-localized storefront falls back to the en-US listing — availability is independent of localization, so the app still ships + is purchasable in SG/MY/TH/etc.; what is knowingly forgone is organic search rank + local-language conversion in TH/Malay. Register stays the DEFENSIVE BaZi/couples/typology framing that protects against Guideline 4.3(b): BaZi typology / relationship analysis, analogous to MBTI-pair, NOT Eastern astrology. The US consumer 生肖/五行 bridge lives in onboarding/UX, NOT in this metadata — zodiac/astrology stay on the _doNotUse list and out of every field. The two-person private-invite mechanic + the original BaZi engine are the 4.3(b) engine-not-product differentiator. Constraints: title<=30c, subtitle<=30c (CJK=1), keywords<=100c comma-separated NO spaces after commas, promotionalText<=170c, description<=4000c. iOS description NOT search-indexed (conversion copy only); indexed fields are name>subtitle>keywords. Compatibility Test was REJECTED for the en-US title (contradicts the shipped not-a-generic-quiz framing + self-buckets into the saturated quiz cluster); test/quiz demand is captured via the keyword field + Apple Ads, not the visible title.
_categoryRationale: LIFESTYLE primary (relationship-insight tool, broad social discovery — every successful US peer Co-Star/Pattern/Nebula/CHANI is Lifestyle; the only BaZi apps in Education are invisible at 20-137 ratings). EDUCATION secondary anchors the 'classical Chinese typology study' angle. Both distance from the Entertainment horoscope cluster.

en-US.title: Yuel: BaZi Couples Chart
en-US.subtitle: Two charts · Invite · Study
en-US.promotionalText: Compare two BaZi charts. Five Elements themes of support and friction - not a score. Invite a partner with a private link. No ads.
en-US.description:
Yuel is a BaZi (Four Pillars) couples-chart tool - a relationship typology grounded in classical Chinese cosmology and modern AI. Not Western horoscope. Not predictive matchmaking. Not a compatibility score.

WHAT IT IS

- Two birth charts side by side: Day Masters, Five Elements balance, and classical interaction patterns (combination, clash, harm, penalty)
- A cultural overlay - like an MBTI-pair study: tendencies and friction themes, not a verdict or prediction
- AI chat that references classical BaZi concepts when you ask about your pair
- Private invite link: they add their own birth; you never see their raw details from the link alone

WHAT IT IS NOT

- Not Western astrology, horoscopes, or zodiac signs
- Not fortune-telling or a pass/fail match score
- Not a generic compatibility quiz

FREE vs PAID

Invite path: share a link; when someone new to Yuel joins and adds birth, this pair can open full chapters for you both. Entering someone else's birth yourself may unlock a full six-chapter report as a one-time purchase (about USD 6.99; store price may vary).

Yuel Pro (about USD 7.99/month or 47.99/year; store price may vary): personal natal reading, monthly relationship layers, living-layer tools (timeline / what-if / AI chat with a monthly allowance), and up to 3 synastry unlocks or birth-chart recomputes per month. Couples reports stay available as one-time purchases when monthly unlocks are used up.

Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

PRIVACY

Birth details stay on device and sync to your account for Threads and pair readings. Partner sharing uses a private invite link. Delete a thread or your account anytime. Purchases via RevenueCat. No tracking ads.

ABOUT

Yuel is published by UseONE, LLC. Privacy: https://yuel.hexastral.com/privacy/yuel / Terms: https://yuel.hexastral.com/terms
